title: Advanced Civic Planning
album: Advanced Civic Planning: A Torrance Study Course
description: A 36-episode advanced course in public hearings, land use, housing, transportation, environmental justice, and municipal finance.

episodes.title: Reading a Staff Report Like an Analyst
episodes.summary: A method for testing authority, evidence, findings, and conditions in a planning staff report.

episodes.title: Procedure Is Part of the Decision
episodes.summary: Explains why notice, hearing procedure, records, and fair process are part of a defensible decision.

episodes.title: Ethics, Ex Parte Contacts, and Recusal
episodes.summary: Examines ethical duties, outside contacts, disclosure, bias, and recusal in local hearings.

episodes.title: Equity and Engagement Beyond the Microphone
episodes.summary: Shows how engagement design and evidence can include people who are absent from a hearing room.

episodes.title: The City as a Legal Creature
episodes.summary: Maps local authority through state law, charters, police power, and delegated planning duties.

episodes.title: Who Really Governs a City
episodes.summary: Compares formal authority with administrative, political, economic, and community influence.

episodes.title: Growth Coalitions and Regional Spillovers
episodes.summary: Explains how local development choices distribute benefits and costs across municipal borders.

episodes.title: Evidence, Findings, and the Administrative Record
episodes.summary: Connects governing standards to record evidence and reasoned findings.

episodes.title: Capstone: Run a Defensible Public Hearing
episodes.summary: Applies procedure, evidence, findings, and motion practice to a complete hearing.

episodes.title: The General Plan After Adoption
episodes.summary: Treats the general plan as an implementation system that requires monitoring and adjustment.

episodes.title: Eight Elements, One System
episodes.summary: Explains how California general plan elements interact instead of operating as separate documents.

episodes.title: Making and Evaluating a Community Plan
episodes.summary: Builds a practical framework for community plan goals, evidence, implementation, and evaluation.

episodes.title: Growth Management Across Municipal Borders
episodes.summary: Analyzes regional infrastructure, housing, transportation, and environmental spillovers.

episodes.title: Zoning History, Exclusion, and Legitimacy
episodes.summary: Places zoning tools in their legal and exclusionary history and tests present legitimacy.

episodes.title: Beyond Conventional Zoning
episodes.summary: Compares conventional zoning with form, performance, overlay, incentive, and hybrid tools.

episodes.title: The Five Urban Design Policy Tools
episodes.summary: Compares regulation, investment, incentives, information, and coordination as design tools.

episodes.title: Streets Are Public Places
episodes.summary: Evaluates streets as civic spaces serving access, safety, mobility, commerce, and public life.

episodes.title: Infill, Transit, and Resilient Growth
episodes.summary: Connects infill and transit decisions to resilience, access, displacement, and implementation.

episodes.title: The Housing Element as an Implementation Contract
episodes.summary: Reads the housing element as a schedule of sites, programs, deadlines, and accountable actions.

episodes.title: Reading the APR and HCD Enforcement
episodes.summary: Uses annual progress reports and enforcement guidance to evaluate housing program delivery.

episodes.title: Objective Standards and the Processing Clock
episodes.summary: Separates objective standards from discretion and tracks review deadlines that change local process.

episodes.title: The Ministerial Pathways Decision Tree
episodes.summary: Organizes housing approval pathways by eligibility, objective standards, and current legal authority.

episodes.title: Protecting Housing Capacity After Approval
episodes.summary: Explains how implementation, replacement capacity, monitoring, and enforcement protect planned housing.

episodes.title: From Level of Service to Vehicle Miles Traveled
episodes.summary: Distinguishes traffic operations from environmental transportation impact under current guidance.

episodes.title: Projects, Safety, and Reliable Transit
episodes.summary: Evaluates transportation projects through safety, reliability, access, and development process.

episodes.title: Environmental Justice and Regional Resilience
episodes.summary: Connects cumulative burdens, participation, investment, and climate resilience in regional planning.

episodes.title: Reading Maps, Census Data, and Greenprint
episodes.summary: Builds habits for checking geography, vintage, uncertainty, access, and licensing in planning data.

episodes.title: The Fiscal Test for Every City Decision
episodes.summary: Frames fiscal analysis around recurring revenues, lifecycle costs, risk, and service outcomes.

episodes.title: Revenues and California's Fiscal Constitution
episodes.summary: Maps local revenue tools, legal constraints, volatility, and accountability.

episodes.title: Property Tax and Development Fiscal Impact
episodes.summary: Tests development fiscal claims against property tax allocation, service costs, and timing.

episodes.title: Economic Development and Land Value Capture
episodes.summary: Compares economic development tools and ways public action can recover created land value.

episodes.title: Operating Costs After the Ribbon Cutting
episodes.summary: Identifies staffing, maintenance, renewal, and risk costs that continue after capital completion.

episodes.title: Comparing Project Alternatives
episodes.summary: Uses consistent baselines, lifecycle costs, uncertainty, and public outcomes to compare alternatives.

episodes.title: Municipal Debt and Long-Term Commitments
episodes.summary: Explains debt structure, affordability, disclosure, and long-term fiscal commitments.

episodes.title: Enterprise Funds, Partnerships, and Reserves
episodes.summary: Evaluates restricted funds, partnerships, reserves, and risk allocation in municipal finance.

episodes.title: Capstone: Evaluate a Torrance Project
episodes.summary: Combines legal, planning, transportation, housing, and fiscal tests in a documented project review.
